wines.winemaking: A tribute to the masters of tradition, Albe is a blend of high elevation estate vineyards from Comune di Barolo.
wines.tasting_notes: Infused rose petals, sweet red fruits and a hint of black figs, complete its wide and elegant bouquet.
wines.pairing: This Barolo is extremely versitile, pair with game meats that are roasted or grilled. The traditional pairing with mushrooms adds a complexitiy to the wine.
wines.other_notes: Fossati, Coste di Vergne and La Volta all have different sun exposures, thus the three sunrises (Albe) that can be seen every day. The Vajra family has farmed Bricco delle Viole, the highest cru in Comune di Barolo, since the XVII century, and owned parcels there since the late 1880s. This wine has an amazing scent of cranberries and raspberries. So authentic and yet expressive. Consider fall and winter vegetables.

wines.winemaking: Produced on South-Southeast facing slopes surrounding the village of Lugny with shallow soil made up of limestone. Vines from these vineyards are on average 30 to 35 years old.
wines.tasting_notes: As a cooperative, Cave de Lugny has first access to some of the best fruit that the Mâconnais has to offer. All Chardonnays are unoaked and aged sur-lie, resulting in bright citrus and floral aromas, a round mouthfeel, and complex flavors. A lovely salmon-pink hue that releases fresh and fruity aromas (strawberries and raspberries) on the nose and a hint of minerality. On the palate, a dry and crisp sparkling wine with a tangy finish. With strict growing standards and eco-friendly philosophies, Cave de Lugny ensures the best fruit and highest quality.
wines.pairing: Pairs well with sushi, salmon, white meat or with sweet desserts to highlight the wine’s tangy finish.
wines.other_notes: Founded in 1926, Cave de Lugny is the #1 white Burgundy producer today. Cave de Lugny is a cooperative of grower families.

description_bullets: Champagne, France, Rose, Non Vintage, Pinot Noir, Grand Cru

Laurent-Perrier Cuvée Rosé is made from 100% Grand Cru Pinot Noir grapes. Cuvée Rosé is made using a proprietary maceration technique and is aged for 5 years in chalk cellars. With a light dosage of 9 g/L, this non-vintage champagne is Brut in style.
All of the Laurent-Perrier Champagnes are made in 100% stainless in order to ensure the freshness for which the house is renowned.

Brilliant character and fine sparkle. Intense and complex nose of slightly candied fruits, pastry, grilled almonds, hints of honey and gingerbread. Grand Siècle perfectly balances strength and delicacy.

Cuvée Rosé is both delicious as an aperitif and a versatile food pairings. Salmon, prawns, duck, and foie gra are excellent matches, as are Thai and Vietnamese dishes. In addition, Cuvée Rosé pairs well with creamy cheese such as Brie or Mt.Tam.

wines.winemaking: After fermentation and light pressing, the lots were aged up to 17 months in a combination of French and American oak barrels. We have earned the SIP (Sustainability In Practice) Certification for Margarita Vineyard.
wines.tasting_notes: Deep, savory aromas of black cherry and plum with notes of vanilla, tobacco and spice. Bright, brambly flavors of raspberry and boysenberry with a juicy texture of black tea and cedar. Fresh acidity adds lift and structure to a sleek, peppery finish Cold-soaked prior to fermentation for a gentle extraction of color and flavor.
wines.pairing: The bright fruit and juicy texture of our Zinfandel make this wine a fitting match for fine comfort foods, including barbecued chicken, grilled sausage, Santa Maria-style tri-tip and vegetarian flatbread.
wines.other_notes: Zinfandel from the estate Margarita Vineyard in the Santa Margarita Ranch sub AVA of Paso Robles, CA Family-owned, all-estate winery. Product received by customer may not be the same product that was made in the year in which the award or accolade was given.

description_bullets: Zinfandel from the estate Margarita Vineyard in the Santa Margarita Ranch sub AVA of Paso Robles, CA

Deep, savory aromas of black cherry and plum with notes of vanilla, tobacco and spice. Bright, brambly flavors of raspberry and boysenberry with a juicy texture of black tea and cedar. Fresh acidity adds lift and structure to a sleek, peppery finish

The bright fruit and juicy texture of our Zinfandel make this wine a fitting match for fine comfort foods, including barbecued chicken, grilled sausage, Santa Maria-style tri-tip and vegetarian flatbread.

Cold-soaked prior to fermentation for a gentle extraction of color and flavor. After fermentation and light pressing, the lots were aged up to 17 months in a combination of French and American oak barrels.

wines.tasting_notes: This is a quintessential Mendocino County Zinfandel, full of dense black cherry flavors, lively tannins, and a touch of mesquite on the finish. wines.winemaking: Aged in French Oak barrels for 16 months. Matetic has 470 acres farmed organically (certification by CERES),under biodynamic principles (Demeter cert) to achieve 100% natural grapes
wines.tasting_notes: Clone 174, produce aromatic well-balanced wines with long finish combining with clones 470 + 300, yield very concentrated wines with long, silky tannings and red fruit expression. Deep and lively purple in color and intense aromas of red fruits, violets, and black pepper with notes of chocolate and spices from the oak. The palate has big body and intensity, balanced and complex, long tannins and a very juicy finish.
wines.pairing: This wine is ideally served with duck, juicy steak, smoked red meats, sweet and sour dishes, and aged or smoked cheeses.
wines.other_notes: Matetic Vineyards established by Jorge Matetic in 1999 in the Rosario Valley (Casablanc & San Antonio DO). And not to be missed with dark chocolate deserts.
wines.grid_title: Matetic | Matetic Corralillo Syrah, 750 ML
description_bullets: Clone 174, produce aromatic well-balanced wines with long finish combining with clones 470 + 300, yield very concentrated wines with long, silky tannings and red fruit expression. Aged in French Oak barrels for 16 months.

Matetic Vineyards established by Jorge Matetic in 1999 in the Rosario Valley (Casablanc & San Antonio DO). Matetic has 470 acres farmed organically (certification by CERES),under biodynamic principles (Demeter cert) to achieve 100% natural grapes

Deep and lively purple in color and intense aromas of red fruits, violets, and black pepper with notes of chocolate and spices from the oak. The palate has big body and intensity, balanced and complex, long tannins and a very juicy finish.
This wine is ideally served with duck, juicy steak, smoked red meats, sweet and sour dishes, and aged or smoked cheeses. And not to be missed with dark chocolate deserts.

vivino_enrichment.method: Per-wine web search restricted to vivino.com (brand + wine name), then a read of each candidate wine page: rating, rating count, title, winery, grapes and region from the page header and facts. A match is kept only when the page names the same producer and the same wine as the Whole Foods listing (build/vivino_fetch_to_extract.py), and the search did not doubt the cuvee. The grapes listing was used to learn the site structure, not crawled. robots.txt-disallowed paths (/reviews/, /users/) were not visited. Word clouds come from the first page (up to 10) of each wine's public reviews JSON (/api/wines/<id>/reviews, not disallowed by robots.txt): descriptor terms per English review, counted in code. Review texts, reviewer names and profiles are never stored.
vivino_enrichment.reviews_note: Only term counts are kept; see reviews_counted and word_cloud per wine.
